rationale: Primary pickup set to the minimum allowed by load-avoidance: max_load_current_a (420 A) x load_margin_multiplier (1.2) = 504 A. This maximizes sensitivity (min_fault_current_a / pickup = 1800/504 = 3.571 >= 1.5) and keeps the pickup below the sensitivity limit 1800/1.5 = 1200 A. Secondary pickup = 504/100 = 5.04 A, within the 1.0-10.0 A relay range. Time delay set to the minimum selective value: downstream_time_delay_s (0.35 s) + selectivity_margin_s (0.30 s) = 0.65 s, within the 0.0-2.0 s range.
